components.description: Independently execute declared quant operations against public and synthetic inputs.
Bind public quantity vocabulary to the operation checked by the executable invariant.
Force the Worker to choose and test an explicit flip index for minimum-history and warmup clauses.
Statically detect a signal expression that combines windows formed at different information-set endpoints.
Catch empty model-response exceptions at the reachable model-call wrapper, inject a short completion directive, and retry within a fixed local budget.
Register an independent public-clause checker and require the Worker to audit and revise its implementation before finalization.

hypotheses.evidence_gap: The free-form Worker probe did not discriminate official T12 outcomes.
hypotheses.expected_worker_change: An independently executed invariant should reject incorrect lag, sign, and portfolio behavior.

hypotheses.evidence_gap: The initial invariant correctly executed an operation that the Worker had selected from a wrong public interpretation.
hypotheses.expected_worker_change: The Worker must bind average return to arithmetic mean before the invariant can pass and must revise a mismatched final strategy.

hypotheses.evidence_gap: T18 H0 passed all 14 Type B properties but only 2 of 4 Type A properties; its classifier silently deferred classification until the 121st monthly observation.
hypotheses.expected_worker_change: The Worker should load the contract-arbitration skill, execute an exactly-120 fixture, state the chosen flip index, and revise any silent warmup fencepost.

hypotheses.evidence_gap: The prior T24 candidate passed all Type-B properties but retained one Type-A failure while mixing a current-inclusive cumulative window with a strictly-causal expanding mean in one signal.
hypotheses.expected_worker_change: The Worker should invoke the audit, align every component of the signal to one formation-time endpoint, and produce a strategy that can be officially evaluated.

hypotheses.evidence_gap: Two endpoint-audit Worker attempts ended before artifact delivery when a 32000-reasoning-token response contained neither content nor a tool call.
hypotheses.expected_worker_change: The reachable model-call wrapper should recover a bounded empty response, allow the Worker to deliver strategy.py, and preserve endpoint auditing in the completed implementation.

hypotheses.evidence_gap: T26 H0 produced all required functions but used only two late self-written invariant checks and passed 13 of 17 properties.
hypotheses.expected_worker_change: The Worker should call an independently registered public-clause audit after implementation revisions, consume its findings, and improve property completion without damaging a solved protection task.

trials.observation: The Worker cited average return but selected additive sum, and the independent tool self-confirmed that selected operation.
The final Worker selected average_return, revised failed checks, and passed the final semantic-bound invariant.
An independent Worker repeat with the same harness passed all T12 properties.
The repaired composition preserved the already solved T19 protection task.
The Worker repeatedly used the structured invariant and passed its local checks, but T01 remained 2/17, equal to the parent baseline. The composition activated but did not transfer.

The Worker loaded the evolved skill, executed an exactly-120 fixture, changed the classifier so the 120th observation was the first classified row, and documented that public reading. T18 nevertheless remained Type A 2/4 and Type B 14/14, exactly matching H0; the warmup-fencepost hypothesis is therefore unsupported as a sufficient cause.
The final model request exhausted 32000 reasoning tokens and returned empty content with no tool call. No strategy.py was produced and the verifier did not run, so component effect is unmeasured.
The single replacement reproduced the same 32000-reasoning-token empty response and missing artifact. It did not reach the verifier; no third retry was run.

The reachable wrapper caught two consecutive 32000-reasoning-token empty-response exceptions and the third call continued to a delivered strategy.py and official evaluation. The endpoint audit also ran, but T24 regressed to Type A 5/7 and Type B 6/10; delivery recovery is directly supported while the benchmark composition is unsupported.

The Worker invoked the independent checker three times and revised its code between audits. T26 improved from H0 13/17 to 14/17, with Type A increasing from 5/7 to 6/7 while Type B remained 8/10; binary reward stayed zero.
The independent repeat again invoked the checker three times but regressed to 12/17, below H0. The one-property target gain is not stable.

T19 improved from its prior shell-only 16/18 to 18/18 even though the T26-specific checker reported two irrelevant failures on every audit. The protection success therefore supports the broader revision workflow, not the task-specific static assertions alone.

notes: The final component was investigator-seeded rather than autonomously discovered by the Evolver.
The repaired composition has two T12 successes and one T19 protection success, but a T01 transfer failed at the parent baseline despite repeated tool use.
The semantic-binding component has not been evaluated alone, so individual component necessity is untested.
This ledger records a mechanism canary rather than a QuantCodeEval benchmark estimate.
The T01 result supports task routing or a new T01-specific capability rather than global reuse of the T12 composition.

The Evolver autonomously discovered and activated warmup-boundary arbitration on T18, but the unchanged 16/18 score rules out that intervention as a sufficient explanation; percentile and early-NaN alternatives remain unresolved.

The Evolver autonomously discovered and smoke-tested window-endpoint consistency for T24, but two terminal empty-response attempts produced no artifact. Its standalone benchmark status remains unmeasured.

A later Evolver-discovered wrap-model-call recovery caught the exact repeated empty-response failure twice and delivered an officially evaluated artifact. The composed T24 Worker nevertheless regressed to 11/17, so process recovery and benchmark benefit must be interpreted separately.

The regressed Worker artifact repeatedly applied a non-idempotent percent-to-decimal transform as data flowed across components. A unit-state or transformation-lifecycle component is the next hypothesis, but it has not yet been autonomously selected or tested and is therefore not registered as a measured component.

The T26 breadth Evolver autonomously created and activated a clause-semantic revision loop. Its target evidence is mixed at the property level (14/17 then 12/17 versus 13/17 H0), while T19 improved from 16/18 to 18/18 despite task-mismatched checker failures. The next experiment must ablate the task-specific checker from the general revision workflow before assigning causal credit.
